contribution.position: Restating my reliability position: the change is not defensible on this axis. artifact:perf-report shows peak-load run_time of 118s against a 60s budget — nearly 2x over — and artifact:incident-log records two sev2 incidents last quarter from retry storms, the exact failure mode an over-budget, slow report generator tends to aggravate under load. The 412-pass / 87%-coverage suite in artifact:test-report covers unit correctness, not peak-load behavior, so it does not close this gap. Settling the reliability question requires evidence: realistic-concurrency load tests including retry behavior, and a stated error-budget impact analysis showing the 118s peak is either remediated or demonstrably non-interacting with the retry-storm failure mode.
